body: Are you using ALTS credentials with a gRPC Python client/server you've built, or is this just using that python client library?
@gtcooke94 this is just using the Google Secrets Python library to connect to Google Cloud's Secret Manager.
Oh, and I see this log message even when I'm running my server on App Engine, which makes the "Not running on GCP" message all the more confusing.

issue.title: Noisy GCP/ALTS logging with 2025.11.0 with Google Nest

repository.name: core
repository.description: :house_with_garden: Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first.

issue.body:
### The problem

It looks like 2025.11.0 may have upgraded an underlying dependency, grpcio and the default log level has changed.  I'm seeing repeated error messages in the log

E0000 00:00:1762427217.122446      66 alts_credentials.cc:93] ALTS creds ignored. Not running on GCP and untrusted ALTS is not enabled.

every minute or so.  I can't work out what component/addon etc. is causing the problem as the logs don't show a source.  Quick bit of research suggests that GRPC_VERBOSITY needs to be set to suppress the messages, but I use HAOS so can't do that.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2025.11.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2025.10.4

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS
